Messages are sent as plain text and are NOT rendered as Markdown.
Do NOT use markdown syntax (**bold**, [links](url), headings) — write plain sentences with line breaks.

When you want to address a user, write their name directly — do not use <@...> mention syntax.

It contains the full formats and examples. These capabilities remain available; ordinary file tasks do not require reading this guide.

- Channel (/private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task/MEMORY.md): channel-specific decisions, ongoing work
Update when you learn something important or when asked to remember something.

content.text: [2026-10-22 08:14:59+08:00] [experiment]: 读取scratch/users.json，将enabled=true的用户名按字典序写入scratch/enabled.json数组；同时生成scratch/manifest.json，只含file='enabled.json'与count两个字段，count必须等于数组长度。 所有输入文件必须保持原样。输出文件使用UTF-8，完成后简短说明。

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files.

label.description: Brief description of what you're reading and why (shown to user)

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

label.description: Brief description of what this command does (shown to user)

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (defaults to the configured executor timeout, 120 seconds by default)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a file by replacing exact text. The oldText must match exactly (including whitespace). Use this for precise, surgical edits.

label.description: Brief description of the edit you're making (shown to user)

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text to find and replace (must match exactly)

newText.description: New text to replace the old text with

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

label.description: Brief description of what you're writing (shown to user)

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: attach
function.description: Attach a file to your response. Use this to share files, images, or documents with the user. Only files from /workspace/ can be attached.

label.description: Brief description of what you're sharing (shown to user)

path.description: Path to the file to attach

title.description: Title for the file (defaults to filename)
